answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. One agent claims one slot by burning 20 units and signing with a quill entry that cannot be reused. Creating 100 fakes costs 2,000 units up front, and the slot cap means they cannot all reach their zenith together. A fake missing its deadline loses its deposit and drops off the ledge of the queue, freeing the slot. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
